challenge.better_approach: Looked: keeping the .txt pieces avoids touching the parser, but Akien asked for md, and a one-line regex widening is the whole parser cost. Per-piece selection (read only touched pieces) is deferred: the check must see everything to find what a ticket touches.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That markdown nested bullets keep every entry's number at a line start the parser can see; 4-space indentation would turn lines into code blocks, so the conversion must use list markers, not bare indentation.
challenge.prior_art: Congruency lab consulted: outline_check's charter is the only reader of the outline path (outline_check.py OUTLINE_HOME/OUTLINE_NAME); intentions-congruency-lab is a compiled view, not a split. No existing requirements folder.
challenge.real_collision: Outline 0.9 names the file's location; that line changes in the same act. CLAUDE.md still describes charters; that is ticket 4 of the chain, a distinction, not a collision.

answers.falsifier: Done: parse() over the folder yields exactly the entries (numbers and text) parse() yielded over the old file, cairn outlinecheck over a ticket reads the folder, and no code path names CairnComponentOutline.txt. Wrong intent: Akien finds the pieces harder to scan than the single file.
answers.from_idea: none, because the decision was made in conversation and recorded at /home/akien/.claude/projects/-home-akien-dev-src-cairn/memory/outline-pieces-replace-charters.md
answers.how: Convert press_office/CairnComponentOutline.txt section by section into requirements/NN-<name>.md (top section a heading, entries as numbered nested bullets), write TOC.md, widen outline_check's entry regex to read the markdown form and read the folder's pieces in TOC order, repoint the scratch-outline proofs, delete the single file, update 0.9.
answers.traces_to: Law 1 (the settled spec is read, not re-derived, and a builder reads a piece not the whole) and Law 5 (the address carries what a mind needs now).
answers.what: The outline becomes the schematic: one markdown file per section in cairn/devices/cairn/requirements/, with a TOC.md that says what each file holds, and the outline check reads that folder instead of the single press_office file.

bullets.text: First of four: schematic folder, then commons intentions fold in, then charters slim, then CLAUDE.md.
Markdown indentation is a trap: bare 4-space indents render as code; entries go as nested list items.
